title: Stream Agent simulations
description: simulations/*.yaml: conversations to put the agent through, each a brief for a model playing the caller and what has to be true at the end. Together the files are the whole of the agent's simulations: one taken out is deleted on the next sync.
$comment: Written by getstream agents init. Edits are overwritten.

name.description: Unique among the agent's simulations, and what a sync finds it again by.

scenario.description: What the caller wants, in your own words and over as many turns as it takes. A brief rather than a script: it may depend on what the agent says back.

assertion.description: What has to be true at the end for a run to have passed.

mode.description: text hands the agent the words; audio speaks them and runs the whole pipeline, so what is judged is what a caller would have heard.

variations.description: How many ways of asking the same thing one run tries. The scenario as written is always the first of them.

max_turns.description: How many times the caller may speak before the conversation is stopped.

caller_target.description: The model that plays the caller. Left out, llm-scenario-runner.

anyOf.description: A capability shortcut the router resolves to a model.

judge_target.description: The model that rules on the conversations against the assertion. Left out, llm-judge.

anyOf.description: A capability shortcut the router resolves to a model.

caller_stt.description: How the caller hears the agent. Audio simulations only.

anyOf.description: A capability shortcut the router resolves to a model.

caller_tts.description: How the caller speaks. Audio simulations only.

anyOf.description: A capability shortcut the router resolves to a model.

caller_voice.description: The voice the caller speaks in. Audio simulations only.

tags.description: Cost labels carried onto every request the simulation makes.
